1.Nf3 e6 2.c4 a6 3.Nc3.strategy: Develops the knight to a square from which it controls b5, d5 and e4. Black's ...a6 hints at a queenside advance, and with the c4 pawn the knight makes that advance harder to carry out.

1.Nf3 e6 2.c4 a6 3.Nc3 c5.strategy: Takes space on the queenside and the d4 square, and builds the a6 and c5 structure that supports a later challenge to the c4 pawn. Black has not yet decided how to set up in the centre.
